prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, high-fidelity ui-mockup.
Asset type: one adjusted Vietnamese desktop Admin examination-list screenshot for the existing ExamPlatform project. Input image one is the actual edit target, the original Admin exam-list desktop V4 image. Input image two is a supporting style reference, the retained Admin preflight-ready image. Edit the first image into one coherent screen. Use the second image only for the shared paper/check logo, calm white surfaces, compact shell, readable information hierarchy, and Cobalt–Apricot visual vocabulary. Do not reproduce its editor, stepper, checklist, questions, or publish actions inside this list. The requested result is a raster design proposal, not a component board or a set of pages.

Preserve the original page identity and business content. This is the page at /admin/exams, used by an authorized administrator to browse loaded examinations, open a draft for editing, create a new draft, or reach a contextual action menu. Do not display the route or this design instruction in the product. Keep the six original examinations, original durations, dates, categories, revisions, publication states, local search scope, and footer count. The adjustment solves narrow action columns, fragmented revision metadata, excessive row padding, and inconsistent branding. It does not introduce a new product feature or change examination lifecycle rules. Every visible word must be clear Vietnamese with correct diacritics.

Keep a bright Soft Bento/Tactile Cobalt–Apricot direction. Canvas must read as cool very pale blue #F3F6FC, surfaces white #FFFFFF, primary Cobalt #315CF4, accent Apricot #FFB36B, pale blue tint #E8EEFF, main ink #1B2540, and muted text #58627A. Avoid purple or lavender drift. Use a restrained green for actual published status, warm apricot for draft status, and neutral slate for archived status, always with readable text and a small icon. Use Be Vietnam Pro style typography, with selective JetBrains Mono style numeric details. Main heading approximately 30 logical pixels, body 16, secondary table text no smaller than 14. Do not shrink text to fit columns.

Maintain a desktop composition equivalent to a 1280 logical pixel page, with approximately 72 logical pixels of white navigation rail and a 68 pixel white top header. Keep the rail compact. Its business destinations remain Overview, Exams, Questions, Import, Monitoring, Reports, with Exams active; icon-only navigation is acceptable here because the original list uses it. Replace the graduation-cap logo at the rail top with the simple paper examination/check symbol in a Cobalt rounded square, following input two. The header wordmark is exactly “ExamPlatform”, next to the small “Quản trị” badge. At right keep account “Minh Anh”, preferably initials “MA” and a discreet chevron. Remove the small “V4” page badge. No new notifications, global search, infrastructure, billing, or technology destinations.

Give the main region a modest 24–32 pixel gutter. Its compact opening contains breadcrumb “Quản trị / Đề thi”, heading “Đề thi”, and helper “Quản lý bản nháp, lịch thi và phiên bản phát hành”. Put secondary “Làm mới” and primary “Tạo bản nháp” at the right, with small refresh and plus icons. Preserve the hierarchy without a large hero or an enlarged illustration. The list is the page focus. White controls have rounded corners around 12 pixels and approximately 44 pixels height. Cards have 20–24 pixel corners, fine pale borders, a very light shadow, and moderate padding. Use an eight-pixel spacing rhythm. The image should feel readable and efficient, not compressed or crowded.

Use one large white table card. Its toolbar begins with search placeholder “Tìm trong các đề đã tải”. Alongside are closed selects “Tất cả trạng thái” and “Tất cả danh mục”. Below, preserve the visible scope explanation “Tìm kiếm và lọc chỉ áp dụng cho các đề đã tải”. These controls act only on loaded items and must never look like whole-database search. Keep them in one balanced desktop row with adequate room for labels. Do not add selection checkboxes, mass deletion, exports, a global examination total, numbered pagination, fabricated online counters, or extra KPI cards. The screenshot depicts the ordinary loaded state, without an open dropdown, dialog, loading spinner, error, or successful mutation toast.

The table has exactly five columns: “Đề thi”, “Thời lượng”, “Lịch thi”, “Trạng thái”, “Thao tác”. Allocate around 33%, 9%, 23%, 23%, and 12% of usable table width respectively, adapting gently if needed so text remains readable. Examination names are the strong leading content and can wrap naturally to two lines. Category sits beneath the name as a compact label. Remove all original EXM-8821 through EXM-8826 placeholder identifiers from the visible table: these are unnecessary list metadata and mismatched editor fixtures. Duration remains clear with the unit “phút”. Every schedule uses separate “Mở:” and “Đóng:” lines with full date and hour, and small “Giờ Việt Nam · UTC+7” text. Avoid squeezing the schedule or replacing it with relative dates.

Status is a vertical, left-aligned stack. The badge is followed by meaningful publication information and then a separate, unbroken metadata line “Bản sửa N”. Publication information may wrap intentionally to two readable lines, but the words “Bản”, “sửa”, and the number must not become a three-line column. Revision is not a published-version number. Do not invent labels such as version 4, v2.3, or edition eight. In the final column each row has “Sửa đề” on one single line plus a closed vertical three-dot menu. Give the text and icon enough space and clear separation. Do not allow the edit label to break after “Sửa”. Keep sufficient click-target padding without making every row unnecessarily tall.

Render row one exactly: “TOEIC Reading — Luyện tập 01”, category “TOEIC”, “75 phút”, opening “14/11/2026 08:00”, closing “14/11/2026 12:00”, badge “Đang phát hành”, metadata “Có phiên bản đã phát hành”, then “Bản sửa 7”. Row two: “Nền tảng điện toán đám mây — Bài ôn tập 01”, category “IT Certification”, “90 phút”, opening “15/11/2026 08:00”, closing “15/11/2026 12:00”, badge “Bản nháp”, metadata “Chưa có phiên bản phát hành”, then “Bản sửa 4”. This row is the same draft used in the style reference. It is not newly published merely because the list has been redesigned.

Row three exactly: “Python cơ bản — Vòng tuyển dụng”, category “Tuyển dụng”, “60 phút”, opening “16/11/2026 09:00”, closing “16/11/2026 11:00”, badge “Bản nháp”, metadata “Chưa có phiên bản phát hành”, then “Bản sửa 2”. Row four: “Cơ sở dữ liệu — Kiểm tra giữa kỳ”, category “Đại học”, “45 phút”, opening “17/11/2026 13:30”, closing “17/11/2026 16:00”, badge “Đang phát hành”, metadata “Có phiên bản đã phát hành”, then “Bản sửa 6”. Keep every row aligned to the same column starts and spacing rules, with fine horizontal separators instead of heavy alternating colored cards.

Row five exactly: “An toàn thông tin nội bộ — Đợt 01”, category “Nội bộ”, “30 phút”, opening “01/10/2026 08:00”, closing “01/10/2026 17:00”, badge “Đã lưu trữ”, then “Bản sửa 5”. Do not infer extra publication metadata for this archived row. Archived does not mean permanently deleted. Row six: “IELTS Reading — Bộ luyện tập 02”, category “IELTS”, “60 phút”, opening “18/11/2026 08:00”, closing “18/11/2026 12:00”, badge “Bản nháp”, metadata “Có phiên bản từng phát hành”, then “Bản sửa 8”. This older version is historical: never relabel the row as currently published. All six rows have the same single-line edit action and closed overflow menu.

At the card footer show exactly “Đã tải 6 đề” at left and the softly tinted button “Tải thêm đề” at right. This means six loaded records and a remaining cursor; it is not a total of all examinations. Below the card preserve the compact notice “Chỉnh bản nháp không đổi nội dung các lượt thi đã bắt đầu. Phát hành là một thao tác riêng.” Editing and publishing remain separate actions. No autosave claim, invented update timestamp, AI proctoring, tab blocking, revenue, score chart, questions preview, or destructive confirmation belongs in this screen. Keep all six rows and footer visible in the full-page output. Finish with crisp, legible lettering, unclipped controls, coherent paper/check branding, readable revisions, and a noticeably more compact table while preserving the original business fixture.
